Putting initial findings here: we see correlated CPU/GPU host provisioning events for the affected pool between 07:45–07:52. Worker process cold-starts are taking longer than expected (initial scheduling and model load overlap). Some model variants for FinApp are larger (longer load times) and our continuous-batching warmup optimization didn’t trigger because of short-lived traffic bursts.

Immediate mitigations we’re trying:
- Force-warm a small number of standby workers in the US pool for FinApp (will reduce scale-to-zero gap)
- Enable aggressive KV-cache priming for heavy routes
- Temporary routing policy: send high-priority checkout requests to a pinned reserved instance (if FinApp agrees)

I’ll also pull request traces and host-level logs. If we still see elevated p99 after forced-warm, we’ll escalate to runtime team (Markus).

— Rishi
